rounds.response: I've updated "Payments – Retry & Messaging Behavior v0.1" (linked on PP‑34) with a concrete default proposal for review. rounds.response:
Proposed rule: if the user taps "Try again" while the backend reports PENDING_RETRY for that payment, the client must NOT create a new attempt — it will show "Processing payment…" and poll the in‑flight status until the backend returns a final result or the remaining retry window (max 10s) elapses.  
If no final result by window expiry (retries exhausted), the client shows "Temporary issue" with an enabled "Try again" that starts a fresh payment attempt using a new idempotency key; if the user changes payment details/method at any time, treat that as an immediate new attempt.  
Short end‑to‑end summary for #eng‑payments: backend does idempotent retries on network/gateway/internal errors up to 3 total attempts (initial + 2 retries) with exponential backoff (500ms, then 2s) capped at 10s; do not retry hard‑decline codes (return "Card declined" immediately); client displays "Processing…" during server retries, blocks client-side duplicate attempts while in‑flight, and only permits a fresh attempt after retries exhaust or when payment details change.  
@Carlos please confirm the backend can expose PENDING_RETRY + remaining window in the status API; @Maya/@Samir/@Lena/@Inez please confirm the UX/QA/ops implications so I can lock v0.2 and convert to PP‑35 tasks by EOD.
